method: Compute the pre-NQC continuous phase from the published orbital quantities and residual phase at every trajectory state. Fix only its integer-2pi initial gauge against the first complex-mode sample. Feed that phase to the development-only full-series NQC phase spline and attachment while retaining the original amplitude matching rows, phase basis, targets, trajectory, and event chart.
stop_rule: If any fixed-input source-preservation gate fails, record attribution and stop before whole replay. If fixed-input gates pass, run eager/JIT whole replay and original eager control. Run AD/FD only if all whole gates pass and predicted resources stay within operational limits.
interpretation: One frozen development chart. Existing release gates and production physics remain unchanged; passing this diagnostic alone would not release qualify the model.
